slots.original: We're excited to unveil a reimagined export experience that empowers teams to seamlessly operationalize their reporting workflows. Leveraging a robust new rendering pipeline, customers on the Pro plan can now unlock CSV and PDF exports of up to 10,000 rows, driving meaningful time-to-insight reductions across the stakeholder landscape. This release represents a pivotal step in our ongoing journey toward a truly frictionless data-sharing ecosystem.
